_readme: Curriculum index for the Darśana branch — a CROSS-CUTTING INDEX, never the bibliographic
hierarchy. A work lives once, under its textual tradition in darshana_works.json; this
file only says which curriculum touches it, at which level, and for what portion.
PROVENANCE IS THE POINT. Every track carries a 'status':
verified   — transcribed from a source that states it is the Tenali syllabus
attested   — the item is confirmed to be a Tenali examination paper (it appears in
published exam results), but its position in the level sequence is not
substitute — a DIFFERENT institution's curriculum, included because it has real portion
detail the Tenali material lacks. Never to be presented as Tenali.
unknown    — deliberately empty. We do not guess.
The official Tenali Tarka and Mīmāṃsā level tables are NOT publicly indexed. Two PDFs
('TENALI EXAMS.pdf' and 'समग्रपरीक्षापाठ्यक्रमः.pdf') are attached to a login-gated
Bhāratīya Vidvat Pariṣat thread — see acquisition.next_actions. Until those are obtained,
tarka.levels stays empty and the attested ladder is recorded separately.

track_durations._conflict: Indica gives Tarka as 6 years (~12 semesters at 2/yr) while Medha Gurukulam states the Nyāya syllabus is 14 semesters. Unreconciled — do not treat either as settled.

tracks.title: Tenali — Tarka (Nyāya)
tracks.note: Deliberately empty. No public source gives the level-by-level Tarka portions. Populate ONLY from the official syllabus document.

attested_ladder.note: Paper names appearing in published exam results, in ascending order of advancement. Positions in the numbered sequence are NOT given by the source. 'Gadadhari' appears as three distinct examination levels.

additionally_named.quote: A 14 semester syllabus has been outlined as part of Tenali pareeksha. Syllabus includes - Tarka-Sangraha-Dipika, Muktavali, Dinakari, Pancha Lakshani, Siddhantha-Lakshanam, Nyaya Kusumanjali, Nyaya Bhashyam etc.
additionally_named.note: text→semester mapping is not published; the 'etc.' is the source's own

tracks.title: Tenali — Mīmāṃsā
tracks.note: No public level-by-level list. Duration is 7 years.

attested_papers.note: named at the 2025 Sastra Sabha alongside Veda Bhāṣyam

tracks.title: Tenali — Vedānta
tracks.source_note: Transcription by Ajit Krishnan, 1 Oct 2019; pointed to as the reference by the Advaita-L list. Unofficial host, but it states itself to be the Tenali syllabus.
tracks.note: Included because levels 1–3 are shared with the Tarka track and anchor the sequence's foot. Vedānta works themselves live outside darshanas/ (shankara_bhashya/, sarvamoola_grantha/) — this is index-only.

tracks.title: Tenali — Vyākaraṇa
tracks.note: Same shared foot (levels 1–2) as Vedānta. Vyākaraṇa works live in dge/data/vyakarana/ — index-only here.

tracks.title: SUBSTITUTE — Sri Ahobila Math Adarsh Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya, B.A. Nyāya
tracks.institution: Sri Ahobila Math Adarsh Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya (MKM Sanskrit College)
tracks.why_included: the only curriculum found with genuine PORTION detail at the Tarkasaṅgraha→Muktāvalī→Pañcalakṣaṇī stage; use to model portion granularity, NOT to claim Tenali sequencing

levels.portion: Tarka Saṅgraha with Dīpikā (Annambhaṭṭa); Nyāyabodhinī (Govardhana) — four pramāṇas
Nyāya Siddhānta Muktāvalī — Pratyakṣa pramāṇa kāṇḍa, 68 verses
Pañcalakṣaṇī (Tattvacintāmaṇi with Gadādhara's gloss on the Dīdhiti) — five lakṣaṇas; Caturdaśalakṣaṇī — 1st lakṣaṇa; Mīmāṃsā Nyāyaprakāśa

tracks.title: SUBSTITUTE — Sri Ahobila Math, M.A. Nyāya (hetu-grantha stage)
tracks.why_included: the clearest published mapping of the advanced vāda texts to teaching units — directly informs the topic × layer model

levels.portion: Pakṣatā (Tattvacintāmaṇi + Dīdhiti, Gadādhara) — up to śiṣādhayiṣā; Avayava Gādādharī — sat-hetu and avayava-lakṣaṇa; Nyāyasūtra Bhāṣya (538 sūtras); Śaktivāda
Pakṣatā-2 — up to pakṣa; Avayava Gādādharī-2 — pratijñā-lakṣaṇa; Nyāyasūtra Bhāṣya-2; Śaktivāda — tat-padārtha to kim-padārtha
Hetvābhāsa Sāmānya-nirukti-1 (Gadādhara) — 1st hetvābhāsa lakṣaṇa; Nyāya Kusumāñjali — 1st of 5 stabakas; Vyutpattivāda; Praśastapāda Bhāṣya
Sāmānya-nirukti-2 — 2nd lakṣaṇa; Nyāya Kusumāñjali — 2nd stabaka; Vyutpattivāda-2 — dvitīyā vibhakti; Praśastapāda Bhāṣya cont.
Tarka Saṅgraha with Dīpikā; Laghu Siddhānta Kaumudī
